_comment: One-line purpose per ml-train run number, shown on status.html. Runs dispatched after 2026-08-08 carry their doc in the run name itself (workflow `doc` input); this file backfills history and can override a bad run-name. Keep entries short — one sentence, what and why.
1: First codec on Actions: C=12 NA pilot, d_z=32 (run name 'actions').
2: Bottleneck sweep: d_z=8 — how narrow can the embedding be?
4: Bottleneck sweep: d_z=64 — the width the programme settled on.
5: Bottleneck sweep: d_z=128 — over-wide control (worse than 64).
6: wind14: +2 wind-stress channels on the NA window — first big probe jump.
8: global14: same 14 channels on the full global window (7x the pixels).
11: global14b: exact replication of global14 on another runner — measures codec seed noise (~±0.05).
12: 40k-step dispatch on hosted CPU — cancelled: 1.3 steps/s meant the job would die at timeout with no checkpoint.
13: Same as #12, cancelled with it; led to the --max-minutes wall-clock guard.
17: pixel25_40k: 2nd channel family (8 Argo levels, C=25 with SST), pixel tokens, 40k steps.
18: patch24_40k: the 3x3-patch codec, C=24, 40k — the codec behind the 0.690/0.654 head results.
19: patch24_30k: steps-matched 30k control for the patch codec.
21: pixel24_40k: pixel-token control matching patch24_40k (receptive-field ablation).
30: patch24_1M: the 1M-step headroom run (LR decay to 10% floor, probes every 50k). Verdict: FLAT from 50k to 1M — pilot size is capacity-limited.
31: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch; pre-seeding-fix checkout).
32: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch).
33: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch).
34: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch).
35: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch); these five failures created the data-cache-v1 release seeding.
36: 10M 30k — silently trained on CPU at 0.5 steps/s (torch cu130 vs CUDA 12.6 driver); cancelled, led to the driver-matched install step.
37: 10M 60k — failed in build: OSNAP truth server timed out; led to truth files joining the release.
38: patch24 seed-2 — failed in build (same OSNAP timeout).
39: pixel24 seed-2 — trained and uploaded fine, then the box hit 50/50 GB disk and the probes died; checkpoint harvested, probes run in-sandbox.
40: 10M 60k (SUCCESS): ridge 0.578 — first 24-channel run above the wind-only line; MOVE 0.238; head 0.688 (single seed, unconfirmed).
41: patch24 seed-2 re-dispatch — cancelled: its checkout predated the driver fix and could have CPU-trained.
42: 10M 30k re-dispatch — cancelled to free the box for the family-3 builds.
43: patch24 seed-2 (SUCCESS): ridge 0.531, head 0.654 — the replication that retracted the pretraining margin.
44: f3_pilot_40k: FAMILY 3 opens — pilot-size codec on the 0.25-degree NA tensor (C=39, SSH included, axis from 1982).
45: f3_anchor41M first dispatch — cancelled and re-dispatched.
46: 10M 30k steps-matched control (completes the 10M pair with #40): ridge 0.556 [0.44, 0.67], MOVE 0.212 — the pair is 0.556/0.578 at 30k/60k, i.e. no step effect at 10M either.
48: f3_anchor41M: 40.7M params, 60,000 steps (~1 epoch) on the 0.25-degree tensor — the first codec trained AT its Chinchilla data anchor.
49: f3_anchor41M_seed2: second seed of #48's 40.7M / 60,000-step config (the duplicate dispatch was accidental; kept, since the two-seed house rule wanted the replicate anyway).
50: Smoke run for the GPU-probe change — failed at the step-0 probe on `dev.type` (dev is a string, not a torch.device). Exactly what a smoke run is for.
51: Smoke run, second try (SUCCESS): the step-0 probe ran on the GPU in 11 s and scored 0.516 on an UNTRAINED codec — the reference line every probe chart is now read against.
52: Resume smoke test (SUCCESS): proved --resume restores optimizer + schedule, and exposed that the step-0 probe fired BEFORE the weights were restored (fixed: no step-0 probe on a resumed run).
53: f3_anchor41M resume — cancelled: dispatched with 640x10 geometry (50.05M params), which is not #48's model.
54: f3_anchor41M resume — failed: landed on a box with no orphaned checkpoint from #48/#49, so there was nothing to continue.
55: f3_anchor41M resume — failed: geometry mismatch on load. The error line (torch.Size([1728, 576])) is what finally pinned the true anchored codec at d_model=576, not the 640 inferred from its parameter count.
56: f3_anchor41M seedA (fresh) — FAILED at the first full probe (step 10k): codec.query ran the cuda decoder on a cpu channel index (index_select device mismatch). The light probe climbed 0.402→0.582 first, so the codec was training fine; the probe killed it. Fixed and relaunched.
57: f3_anchor41M seedB — same first-full-probe crash as #56.
58: f3_mid10M seedA — same first-full-probe crash as #56.
59: f3_mid10M seedB — same first-full-probe crash as #56.
60: f3_pilot0.9M seedB — cancelled: it would have hit the same probe crash at step 10k; relaunched on the fixed code.
61: f3_anchor41M_120k seedC — cancelled: same reason as #60 (its first full probe at 15k).
_parents_comment: Continuations that predate the {"resumed": ...} record train.py now writes. Maps a run number to the run it continues; status.html uses it to prepend the parent's curve so a resumed run charts its WHOLE trajectory. New runs do not need an entry here — the checkpoint carries its own CKPT_TAG.
62: f3_anchor41M seedA — trained ALL 60,000 steps with every probe working (the device fix held), then died in the post-training eval on a 7.04 GiB CUDA OOM. Its finished 40.7M checkpoint survives on its box. Probe story: linear r peaked 0.529 @6k then fell to 0.420 @60k while chan t+1 rose +2.4%→+31.5%.
63: f3_anchor41M seedB — same as #62: full 60,000 steps, same late eval OOM. step-0 linear 0.546 → 0.380 @60k; chan t+1 +1.2% → +32.3%. Two seeds agreeing makes the pooled-probe decline a pattern, not noise.
64: f3_mid10M seedA (SUCCESS): 10.26M ladder midpoint on the 0.25° tensor, 60k steps — completed with full probe ladder and k-fold.
65: f3_mid10M seedB (SUCCESS): second seed of the 10.26M midpoint.
66: f3_pilot0.9M seedB (SUCCESS): 0.92M bottom rung. step-0 linear r_des = +0.568 — exactly the wind-only bar, the cleanest demonstration that an untrained codec is a random-feature view of its own input channels (wind included). Fell to 0.440 by 60k.
67: f3_anchor41M_120k seedC: the 40.7M anchor to 120k steps — step- vs capacity-limited. Dispatched before the eval-OOM fix, so its epilogue may still fail; its checkpoints survive on the box.
68: STAGE 2 on the 40M anchor (#62's frozen codec): no further codec steps, temporal transformer K=24 / 6000 steps / d_model=192 / 4 layers over the frozen 40.7M embeddings, plus the probe ladder.
69: STAGE 2 on the 40M anchor seed B (#63's frozen codec): the replicate of #68.
